sentence: This project builds tools to design and test changes inside cells and to make cells that create useful products.
This project installs a helium liquefaction system to give superconducting magnets a steady supply of liquid helium.
This project uses yeast genetics to study how cells form autophagosomes, the double-membraned vesicles that carry cellular cargo for breakdown.
This project uses genome data to study how three groups of songbirds on islands form separate species and adapt.
This project develops curriculum modules on generative artificial intelligence for courses across many engineering fields.
This project studies where the fungus that causes Valley Fever grows in soil and how conditions could spread the disease.
This project develops robotics lessons and teacher guides for pre-college engineering education.
This project studies what signals make cells produce the enzymes that crosslink collagen as tendons form.
This project combines long term data from many research sites to find general patterns in how ecosystems work.
This project develops quantum logic operations that keep the built-in error protection of bosonic encodings.
This project studies how the brain combines vision, muscle sense and balance to control movement and stay steady around moving objects.
This project explores using molecules released by stem cells, instead of live cells, to help skin repair and heal wounds.
This project studies how pressure from growing tumors squeezes immune cells and stops them from finding and destroying cancer cells.
This project builds a program that combines cybersecurity coursework with artificial intelligence to protect government systems from threats.
This project tests a way to measure how energy, water and carbon move between land and air more accurately using tower data.
This project studies how clinics, tech companies and schools shape which youth with diabetes get and use insulin pumps and glucose monitoring devices.
This project builds software that checks whether engineered biological systems behave reliably in noisy conditions, using probabilistic model checking.
